title: Delta Lake Table Maintenance on Databricks: OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER vs Liquid Clustering, and VACUUM
author: Karan Pulyala
brief: Most Delta tables don't get slow because of one bad query. They get slow because nobody looks after...
fact: Triggers: Schedule (wall-clock), Tumbling window (fixed, non-overlapping intervals with backfill, retry and dependencies), Storage event (blob created/deleted), and Custom event.
